video.title: AI欧腐《30天让他爱上我不然就下地狱/30 Days To Hell-Or Become His Sweetheart》
video.desc:
Bound as a slave to his former servant Sebastian, arrogant heir Theodore must seduce him within 30 days to escape hell. But as the Affection Meter’s secret surfaces, the line between revenge and obsession shatters."Make me love you? Too late, sweetheart. I already loved you for a long time."
傲慢的继承人Theodore沦为昔日仆人Sebastian的奴隶，他必须在30天内让对方爱上自己，才能逃离地狱。可随着"好感度计量表"的秘密浮出水面，复仇与执念之间的界线彻底崩塌。
"让我爱上你？太迟了，甜心。我早就爱了你很久很久。"
